evidence: log loss +0.0119 (95% interval +0.0002 to +0.0221). The model's probabilities are WORSE than the market's closing probabilities (the interval is above zero).

182 picks, ROI -1.0% (95% interval -13.0% to +9.8%), win rate 58.8% against a break-even 58.8%. Random sides at the same margin match or beat this 31% of the time. Line movement toward the pick after it was made: +0.07 probability points on average (zero means no closing-line value).
How many bets before ROI can be trusted

At the observed spread of results, detecting a true 3% ROI takes about 4,935 bets and a 5% ROI about 1,777; a 1% edge takes 44,407. Closing-line value converges much faster, which is why it is the primary measure.
